test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A sting in the tail

options.text: An unexpected, typically unpleasant or problematic end to something
To initiate a situation that is very complicated or problematic
A situation in which a large group has to do something to satisfy a small group
Something which seems bad at first but contains a pleasant part at the end

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Idiom '**A sting in the tail**' means an unexpected, typically unpleasant or problematic end to something(अंत में आश्चर्यजनक और चौंकाने वाला)

 
 
• **Example**-The movie had a great start, but there was a real** sting in the tail **at the end
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is '**An unexpected, typically unpleasant or problematic end to something**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• To initiate a situation that is very complicated or problematic(जटिल समस्या शुरू करना)- **To open a can of worms**

 
 
• **Example**-Bringing up the topic of politics at the family dinner** opened a can of worms** as everyone had strong opinions
 
 
 
• A situation in which a large group has to do something to satisfy a small group(अल्पसंख्यक को खुश करने के लिए बहुसंख्यक को कुछ करना पड़ता है)-**To bend over backwards**
 
 
• **Example**-The company had to** bend over backward** to accommodate the needs of their small but influential client base
 
 
 
• Something which seems bad at first but contains a pleasant part at the end(शुरु में बुरा लगता है, लेकिन अंत में अच्छा होता है)-**A blessing in disguise**
 
 
• **Example**-Losing my job turned out to be **a blessing in disguise** because it led me to a much better opportunity.
 
 

57:Tcae,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
